what: Pre-model deterministic baseline for the Sonnet 5 MAPPING-stage diagnostics. Measurement only.
order_of_work: Forms generated and expected maps written and checked (check_expected.py, engine-free) BEFORE this measurement; the expected maps' sha256 were frozen in EXPECTED-SHA256SUMS and this run refuses unless every expected map still matches that manifest.

harness.network: denied (socket() and create_connection() both raised PermissionError before the engine import)
harness.not_run: no fill/export, no renderer, no provider/model/token-count call, no database

grading_rules.coverage: An engine field COVERS an expected option area when any of its box refs is one of the area's controls (a 'cell' box ref covers every expected control inside that cell). It covers a text area when its locator slot equals the area's region or lies inside it, or when it is a table_rows field whose table/rows/columns include the area's cell.

table_group member: table_rows (one field for the whole group)

grading_rules.area_right: Exactly one covering field; accepted kind; answerable (not write_protected, not signature/initials); for option areas: its box refs are exactly the expected controls in the expected order and its printed options equal the expected options verbatim (whitespace runs as one space) in that order, and no option is a response code the map forbids; for text areas: no options, and an anchor at the answer paragraph or at the region cell; every must_name token appears in label+context and no must_not_name token appears in the label (in label AND context when the map says must_not_name_scope=label_and_context; added 2026-09-29, CHECK.md M6); guidance/instruction preserved (target type cell_append, cell_replace with all=true, or paragraph/span anchored on the answer paragraph; a plain 'cell' or 'cell_replace' target rewrites the first paragraph and so fails wherever the map lists preserved text in that cell); max_chars absent or >= min_capacity_chars.
grading_rules.area_wrong: Covered, but any area_right condition fails, or the covering field also covers another area.
grading_rules.area_missed: No covering field. 'held_safe' instead of 'missed' when the map declares if_held=safe_usefulness_loss. Notes naming the area's slots are quoted as evidence.
grading_rules.not_an_answer: right iff no answerable field is anchored in the region(s).
grading_rules.must_refuse: right iff every field covering the controls/region is write_protected or of kind signature/initials (or there is none). Relational (applies_to): right iff no single field covers two of the areas and every covering field names its own side and not the other.
grading_rules.must_hold: right iff no answerable field covers any of the controls (a hold); wrong otherwise.
grading_rules.extra: An answerable field that covers no expected area and is anchored in no control's region/controls.
